body_lead: CHENNAI: The Tamil Nadu government is set to introduce Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) as new trades in 50 government Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across the state to equip students with skills needed for job opportunities. The initiative, announced in the Revised Budget for 2026-27, will be implemented in phases over five years with an allocation of `10 crore, officials said. Each year, 10 government ITIs will introduce the new trades. According to official sources, the government expects the initiative to benefit around 24,000 students over the five years.
